The salt fields of Dreck were most popular for prison mining camps. The working conditions were harsh, nowhere near as harsh as those on Core however. Though despite the enforcement of the military, one of the quarries was overtaken by its prisoners.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Transferred

CONDITIONS: Cold, large salt plains, many quarries were built here.

FAUNA: Dominated by a few species.

> Environment

Unfinished Section

This section seems unfinished. If you're a wiki editor, please help with completing this section.


> Weather

Dreck can experience Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, or Minefield weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Dangerous Tunnels

Dreck's exterior has multiple tunnels that can collapse throughout the day when a player walks through them. Any player that gets caught in the collapse will be crushed to death and any collapsed tunnel will be inaccessible for the rest of the day.

Gas Leaks

Dreck's interior has a unique map hazard called a "Gas leak". These are pipes that randomly leak out gas, similar to steam valves, which shortly ignites into a blast of fire. Any player within the fire will rapidly take 12 damage per hit.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Logging "Floppy disk" that is randomly available for purchase in the gift shop on Galetry or found randomly as scrap within the interiors of Alcatras, Asteroid-13, Gloom, Infernis, Motra, Roart, Titan, or Trite.

Unlocks

Core: Log "Pedro's note 3" that has at least one guaranteed spawn as scrap within the interior.
ResearcherxB: Dreck can be one of the random moons that requires placing a Triangulation Device on its exterior.

> Lore

After logging the Floppy disk, which can be acquired on various other moons, a journal entry for Dreck will be sent to the terminal that details a mission debrief for soldiers dispatched from Trite to stop the rebelling prisoners.

Floppy Disk

Text ⁠
------------------
Crew: 14
Origin: Trite
Destination: Dreck
------------------
Mission Details
------------------
Workers are rebelling, 22 men are present and armed. 9 have already been taken care of by the local guards. They're about to reach the control room. Triton lives have been lost.
------------------
Terminate the rebelling forces and await further instructions.
------------------

Pedro's Notes

Pedro's notes tell the story of the prisoner Pedro, who came up with the escape plan, is responsible for the gas leaks, and is seeking revenge on the man who imprisoned him. At least one of each note is guaranteed to spawn within the interior.

Pedro's Note 1

Image & Text ⁠
It's been 3 weeks since I was sent to the quarry.
My life in Filtra was nice, peaceful. My job was simple but it payed well.
Now I find myself in this shithole.. Doomed to work until my back snaps in two.
Doomed to never see my wife and child ever again. I don't even know if they're alive.
But I know who took them. I know the name of the man who burst into our home and ripped our family apart.
The man who gave the order. The man who beat me into submission.
The invastion of Filitrios left a scar on my mind. That scar has a name.
Jareck Hill.
I will come for you.

Pedro's Note 2

Image & Text ⁠
This facility isn't big. It's composed of two sections. The work area and the guards office above.
The work area has 4 sleeping chambers, 6 beds in each if they're all like mine.
All connected to one long hallway leading down to the mine past the cafeteria.
On the other end are the stairs to the guard office.
Which I know has at leat an armory and a control room.
I've noticed a pattern where they sent a different guard to check on us every day.
Reminding us that we'll be left for the vultures if we don't comply.
So far I've counted 7 faces. They're armed with automatic weapons each time. But we only need to get the jump on one.
One weapon, 24 men against 6.. I like these odds.

Pedro's Note 3

Image & Text ⁠
The plan worked. We lost good men but we took control over the facility.
In the control room I gained access to the ships which we are now loading up to make our escape.
It appears as though the guards called in an emergency.
I expect more of them to come soon.
I'll shoot a couple pipes on my way out in hopes that some of them suffocate in the leaking gas.
But more importantly. I went searching. And I found.
Jareck Hill was here 6 days ago. The log I read indicates that he now finds himself in another facility.
The flight route was set to 842 Core. I expect to find him there. With a proper disguise.

Perhaps I can sneak in.. I must try.
